title: Reading Drill — What Made the Community Café Quieter
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: What Made the Community Café Quieter
passages.body:
**A** A community café thought its busiest table was also its noisiest. Volunteers measured sound near several tables and marked which surfaces were close to large windows.

**B** The largest improvement came from adding soft panels above tables against the back wall. The panels changed the echo without requiring fewer customers or a different opening schedule.

**C** The café also moved a chair away from the door. That change affected only one table but reduced complaints because customers no longer had to move each time someone entered.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Volunteers measured sound near several tables and marked which surfaces were close to large windows.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The panels changed the echo without requiring fewer customers or a different opening schedule.

questions.prompt: That change affected only one table but reduced ______ because customers no longer had to move each time someone entered.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: That change affected only one table but reduced complaints because customers no longer had to move each time someone entered.

questions.prompt: The café reduced the number of customers to lower sound levels.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The largest improvement came from adding soft panels above tables against the back wall. The panels changed the echo without requiring fewer customers or a different opening schedule.

questions.explanation: The café also moved a chair away from the door. That change affected only one table but reduced complaints because customers no longer had to move each time someone entered.
